task_completion.description: Agent accesses the Nx Witness REST API documentation or interface at the specified endpoint.
task_completion.visual_evidence: Browser window showing https://localhost:7001/rest/v1/ or API documentation/tooling (like Swagger or Postman) being used with the provided credentials.

task_completion.description: Creation of the 'Distribution Hub SOC' Video Wall with autorun enabled.
task_completion.visual_evidence: API response or GUI confirmation showing a new Video Wall object named 'Distribution Hub SOC' with the 'autorun' property set to true.

task_completion.description: Creation of the four specific layouts with correct camera assignments.
task_completion.visual_evidence: Screenshots showing the creation or existence of 'SOC - Parking View', 'SOC - Entrance View', 'SOC - Server Room View', and 'SOC - Overview' with their respective cameras (Parking, Entrance, Server Room, or all three).

task_completion.description: Configuration of the 2x2 screen grid (1920x1080) and assignment of layouts to specific positions.
task_completion.visual_evidence: API calls or configuration screens showing 4 items/screens, each 1920x1080, with layouts assigned to Top-Left (Parking), Top-Right (Entrance), Bottom-Left (Server Room), and Bottom-Right (Overview).

task_completion.description: Creation of the summary report file at the specified path.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A terminal window or text editor showing the content of /home/ga/video_wall_report.txt containing the Video Wall name and item details.

integrity.description: The agent interacted with the REST API rather than just creating a text file manually.
integrity.visual_evidence: Screenshots must show browser activity, curl commands, or API client interactions targeting localhost:7001, not just the final report creation.

integrity.description: The agent did not simply echo the task description into the report file without performing the configuration.
integrity.visual_evidence: Evidence of GET/POST requests to the Nx Witness server to verify the existence of cameras or to push the new configuration.

integrity.description: The agent used the provided credentials and endpoint.
integrity.visual_evidence: Visual confirmation of 'admin' / 'Admin1234!' being used in authentication headers or login prompts.

privileged_info_for_vlm: The Video Wall must be named 'Distribution Hub SOC'. Layouts must start with 'SOC - '. There must be exactly 4 items in a 2x2 grid. The API endpoint is https://localhost:7001/rest/v1/. The report must be saved to /home/ga/video_wall_report.txt. Cameras involved are 'Parking Lot Camera', 'Entrance Camera', and 'Server Room Camera'.
